units.text: INT. ALPINE CABLE CAR - DAY
A glass cabin hangs mid-span between two peaks, swaying in the wind.
Snow-ridged valley two thousand feet below.
The machinery has stopped.
INSPECTOR BALTHAZAR GREY, 50s, long grey coat, folds his hands over a silver-topped cane.
MADAME SOLANGE VEIL, 60s, in sable and diamonds, clutches a jewelled handbag.
COLONEL RUPERT ASHBY, 70s, ramrod straight, medals pinned to his lapel, glares through the window.
MISS PENELOPE DRAKE, 20s, a nurse in a blue cape, sits on the bench with her knees together.
MR. KASIMIR NOVAK, 40s, in a cheap brown suit, sweats and stares at his shoes.
They all turn at once.
Grey knocks his cane against the floor.
Everyone else freezes.
Ladies and gentlemen, I shall be brief. Someone in this cabin killed Lord Pemberton last night.
units.name: GREY

units.text: Preposterous.
units.name: ASHBY

units.text: His body was found in the funicular station with a needle in his neck.
units.name: GREY

units.text: Oh!
units.name: PENELOPE

units.text: Miss Drake, you are the only person here trained to use a hypodermic.
units.name: GREY

units.text: I'm a nurse, not an assassin!
units.name: PENELOPE

units.text: Of course. But you were on his floor.
units.name: GREY

units.text: So was I, Inspector. So was the Colonel.
units.name: VEIL

units.text: Madame, I take exception.
units.name: ASHBY

units.text: Take it, then. I saw you in the corridor at midnight.
units.name: VEIL

units.text: I was returning from the smoking room.
units.name: ASHBY

units.text: In your dressing gown?
units.name: VEIL

units.text: It's cold!
units.name: ASHBY

units.text: Mr. Novak?
units.name: GREY

units.text: I was in my room. All night.
units.name: NOVAK

units.text: Then you will not mind if I search your jacket.
units.name: GREY

units.text: I will!
units.name: NOVAK

units.text: Why?
units.name: GREY

units.text: Because there is a letter in it.
units.name: NOVAK

units.text: From whom?
units.name: GREY

units.text: From the dead man.
units.name: NOVAK

units.text: The cabin sways.
No one speaks.
Wind whistles through the cables.
Read it aloud, Mr. Novak.
units.name: GREY

units.text: Novak draws out an envelope with trembling fingers.
He opens it.
His eyes move.
His lips whiten.
"Whoever finds this, forgive me. I have taken my own life, and I wish it understood that no person is to blame."
units.name: NOVAK

units.text: Suicide?
units.name: PENELOPE

units.text: No, Miss Drake. A man who writes his own suicide note does not first poison himself with a needle in the neck.
units.name: GREY

units.text: Then the letter is forged.
units.name: ASHBY

units.text: The letter is genuine. And that is the interesting thing.
units.name: GREY

units.text: Why?
units.name: VEIL

units.text: Because the handwriting is Mr. Novak's.
units.name: GREY
